mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('order_result_seq')
INSERT INTO order_result (id, total_price, status_id, payment_time, staff_id, patient_id) VALUES(#{id}, #{price}, #{statusId}, #{paymentTime}, #{staffId}, #{patient.id})
mapper.select: SELECT ord.id, ord.total_price, ord.status_id, ord.payment_time, ord.staff_id, pat.id as pat_id, pat.first_name as pat_first_name, pat.mid_name as pat_mid_name, pat.last_name as pat_last_name FROM order_result ord INNER JOIN patient pat ON pat.id = ord.patient_id WHERE 1 = 1 ${searchCondition} ORDER BY ord.payment_time DESC
